title: Quentin and the Letters
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Cyrus Ishikawa, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
